content: Bọng Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kàraama
Bọng dọkha ogbe ahok ọsana kpenamkpen kwa nnangi bọng mayina, ifha bọng aruk abira ahaabh, abira atza atzọkha irerek s'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnwọhngi ocheckhi bi, ọnang ab'atte.

Bọng jima odem kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, otzim bọng eden k'ebherede ka cho arọbh afa, ifha okhoma bọng obiro oyoma bọng, obiro orenga mẹ oronga achibhi pabọng, sa ode na bọng afha ahok asana pẹ.

Wa kẹ okhom bọng, otte okwo ọbọhk ọkhaama bọng, ọbhakhi mẹ ọnang bọng ọchattọhk fa bọng ayeri mana, kwa bọbọng ọmaana ab'atte ani arong, ifha bọng aronga bi, ọchattọhk fẹ-fẹ arang ohokhi ọnọng akpen. Yina, akpen p'ọnọng afon k'atzim kpenamkpen p'ayini Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'ẹmma.
Ọbara fa bọng afọr ka for kọtzami, mmo sabọng kimbiri mbir ma cho mba arọbh afa.

Bọng nonga ka nttem sabọng bi, odem nwa kw'otte ọm-ọnang nnwa kwẹ ettuma k'ogbe kw'osi odik kw'on-ojibhi, mando kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ọm-ọnang bọng ettuma, k'ogbe kwa bọng asi odik kw'on-ojibhi.
Bọng hok asana p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, bọng ahakha eho anang-e, abira akhaama ojora fẹ.

Da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng otzima bọng otzima ochina k'irerek nnuma s'ijibh ekpo, ibiri ikhaama araanga, ọmaana akhekhaho ttara ngekha sa ndong-odong sa mobhi ntto ka nttẹri ọmaana ka mgbegbeho;
irerek s'ikhaam wit ọmaana barli, ọmaana vain ọmaana fig, ọmaana pomegranates, ọmaana ana p'oliv ttara akhọkhọnana;
irerek s'ọchattọhk on-owori, ọttọhk kpenamkpen kibiri iwor; irerek s'atzakpa pẹ ade akonga-akonga ibiri ikhaama opo kw'ọnọng ofho otzum ka mgbegbekho.
K'ogbe kw'idik ikk'bọng ijibha, bọng dọhnga Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, k'irerek-jibhada s'okk'bọng ọnanga.

Bọng bọkha bọng for, ifha bọng aningi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng araam o, bọng echuni kakhaama bi, ahok asana pẹ, ọmaana aphaangi pẹ ttara akpebhi pẹ pa kaam nnangi bọng, k'ewu cha mayina.
Oni mando ode, bọng akhaama ọchattọhk fa bọng achi obenga bọng, bọng asi ihọhm ikkakka sa bọng aruk,
abhaam pabọng ọmaana arukhimaan pabọng ẹmaan k'ọhaabh, asilva ọmaana gol pabọng abira ahaabh, ekpo biphyir pya bọng akhaam ebire ẹhaabh ẹttar-ọttara,
bọng án-age for bọng araama Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, kw'otzim bọng obina k'Ijip, k'irerek s'iwa bọng awobh k'ẹmmọri.

Wa kẹ otzim bọng orenga k'ebherede ch'ẹbarẹkpa ebire ejor-ojora, irerek s'asi anade pa bọng agwo, ibiri ikhaama jọhk p'akkaam-ọkkaam ttara aninang. Wa kẹ ọnangi bọng asi p'afon k'itzakpa s'igaang-ọgaangi.
Ọnang bọng ọchattọhk fa bọng ayeri mana bọng achi k'ebherede, ọchattọhk f'iwa ab'atte an-arong, okhoma bọng obiro oyoma bọng, ifha ojibh inang bọng k'ekponga-nnam.
Wa osi mando ifha bọng aningi for sabọng abọr bi, “Ojibhada kwaman afon k'ẹfa chaman ọmaana agbọhkhiji paman.”
Yina, bọng jima bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, wọ ọnangi bọng ẹfa cha bọng atzim asi ikkọ, ifha otzima mẹ osi ẹjaakhi ch'echekhi chẹ, ch'iwa osi ọnang ab'atte, mach'ode mayina.

Idikha k'ogbe manda wani bọng akpa nnam abọra Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, bọng an-atzọn ikha abẹ, bọng akpobha sẹ abira achunga nho anang sẹ, kaam nsi ẹjaakhi nnang bọng k'ewu cha mayina bi, k'odik-ọkka ńdimi bọng odimi.
Odem nwa kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi odimi idibhon, mando kwa bẹ ádimi bọng, idikha bọng ani nho ahak anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng.
